description: Get the editing state in one call: the front document (name, path, page count, size, margins), the index of that document, the names of every open document, the active layer, and how many objects are selected. Prefer this over chaining document_getInfo and document_listOpen

document_id.description: Which open document to act on: a name (see document_listOpen) or a 0-based index. Defaults to the front document.

name: document_getState
